intro: Every project below is attributed to the employer it was built under, with my share of the repository counted from git history.

entries.org: NU App Solutions · Software Development · remote
items: Real-estate SaaS platform (Mar 2025 – Oct 2026). Vue 3 CRM — 379 of 616 commits, with Google Workspace two-way sync and OpenAI document extraction. Nuxt 3 multi-tenant SSR website engine — 703 of 1,485 commits. Node microservices for the contact and lead lifecycle — 136 of 291. Flutter CRM — 224 of 286 commits and 182 of 189 Dart files. Background GPS mileage tracker — 68 of 97.
EnServicePortal (Jul 2023 – Jun 2025). Offline-first construction defect and inspection app — 170 of 179 commits, ~22,300 lines, Android, iOS and web from one Angular codebase.

HomeFoody (Apr – Sep 2024). Two Flutter consumer apps published to Google Play and the App Store as the only mobile developer — 116 of 132 and 73 of 86 commits — plus their Vue 3 admin console, sole-authored.
EnBuilder purchaser portal (to Sep 2025) — 141 of 253 commits; canvas layout customisation and parking, locker and bicycle allocation from live inventory.
EnCharity portals (2022). Charity and museum back office — 117 of 146 commits; donor and membership portal — 103 of 282.
Marketplaces (2022 – 2024). TradeInSafe B2B wholesale — 475 of 562 commits across three repositories. Shoplocally local commerce — 201 of 338 across four.
SettlementFormPOC (2026). Sole author of a funder-agnostic dynamic form engine.

entries.role: Senior Software Developer · Associate Team Lead
items: EnBuilder (from Feb 2021). Builder sales and inventory platform — ~80% of 2,075 commits, with 1,375 of mine before May 2022. Ten feature modules: projects, inventories, sales deals, package centre, finance, purchaser portal, reports, security.
EnBuilderFieldService (2021 – 2023). The construction field app that preceded EnServicePortal — 81 of 165 commits, with an explicit offline module.
EnCharity donor portal (from Sep 2021). Angular with Ionic and Capacitor, shipped to web and both app stores.
Associate team lead for eight developers (2021 – 2022) — sprint delivery, code review, unblocking and technical risk assessment.
